properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated December 18, [1933]; meeting with Bob [Robert] Gast about finances partially due to the devaluation of the U.S. dollar; includes description of tasks around securing rights to the Canton [Guangzhou] to Lungchow [Longzhou] and preparing to build an airport hangar at Longzhou; mentions [Major Edward and Mrs.] Howard, Max Polin.
